analysis.visual_description: A black-letter board at the yard door, title only, no name of an author under it. Penny-standers beyond. The flag is up. Winter light on the thatch. No face in the frame.

From a post on the left of the yard, the stage. A tall boy in a buff jerkin and breeches, a staff in his hand, three men got up as Spanish swaggerers. The yard is open-mouthed. No face of the man at the post.
Henslowe at the door, lips moving, a hand keeping a count that is not turned toward the yard. Alleyn is on the stage, easy, in a part that does not fill him. The board is still title only.
